p.15 (ii): 'Every Cartesian space-time derivative of A, Beθ, p is uniformly bounded on compact spatial subsets with c ≤q ≤c′ < q∗, for each 0 < c < c′, up to the one-sided boundary τ = 0. The resulting limits of the derivatives are compatible under spatial and time differentiation.'

(3.5) Here Hext is smooth on [0, ∞), with each fixed derivative bounded. The radial swirl heat equation satisfied by K is −∂τK = ∂²rK + r^{−1}∂rK − r^{−2}K.'

statements.what_is_missing: No Lean declaration states Theorem 3.1 as a theorem about fields on 'Ω∗= {(x, t) : τ > 0, q < q∗}' with constants 'h, q∗, Xa, Xext, Xin, e0'; items (i)-(iii) are present in different form (u as periodized curl-potential plus direct angular field; one-sided limits with 'compatible' derivative tensors via exists_smooth_compatible_limits; AllJetsFlat residual via allJetsFlat_residual_of_stages; exact heat exterior K = r^{-1-2h}H_ext(τ/r²) via heatCoefficient/physicalHeat with heat_navierStokesResidual_zero and terminal-extension lemmas). Item (iv) is WEAKER: the paper asserts the two-sided asymptotic 'uθ(√(2Xinτ), 0, 0, 1 −τ) = τ^{−A}(e0 + O(τ^{2h}))' along the path r = √(2Xin τ) inside the axis region; the Lean tree has (a) an exact formula for the BASE field at r = 0 only, ‖baseVelocity (t,0)‖ = (1−t)^{−A}·d.axial 0 (0,0) (BaseResidual.baseVelocity_norm_at_origin), (b) Tendsto atTop at r = 0 for the base (FinalSlowBase.axis_tendsto), and (c) for the assembled candidate only SpeedUnboundedAtOne (∃ points arbitrarily near t = 1 with ‖u‖ > M). No statement with the error term O(τ^{2h}), no evaluation point r = √(2Xin τ), no constants Xin ∈ (0, Xa) or e0, and no asymptotic for the corrected/summed velocity (as opposed to the base). BlowupImplication.finite_time_profile_tendsto_atTop is a scalar lemma with an abstract 'error → 0' hypothesis, weaker than O(τ^{2h}). Also missing as a stated clause: the (iii) uniformity 'for every finite X1 on 0 ≤X ≤X1' — Lean's AllJetsFlat is along a filter l with a weight q, and I did not locate a statement parametrised by X1.
statements.weakens_exported_statement_via_import_pa: NO. The exported theorems assert only '∃ u₀ f, InitialVelocityCondition* u₀ ∧ ForceCondition* f ∧ ¬ (∃ v p, NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness* nu u₀ f v p)'. Along the actual call chain (ComparatorSolution → ComparatorBridge.navier_stokes_breakdown_{R3,periodic} → R3ActualCandidate.selected_compact_candidate / ActualCandidateAssembly.selected_candidate → selected_witness) the only blow-up fact consumed is CandidateProperties.speed_unbounded : SpeedUnboundedAtOne u (mere unboundedness near t = 1), which the tree discharges from the r = 0 divergence. The rate τ^{−A}(e0+O(τ^{2h})) and the path r = √(2Xin τ) are not part of the exported Prop and are not hypotheses of option_C_of_compact_candidate / option_D_of_candidate. So the weaker (iv) makes the Lean intermediate weaker than the paper's Theorem 3.1 but does not change the exported statements. Caveat: closure membership is necessary not sufficient; I traced the call chain by reading proof terms, not by a kernel dependency dump.

statements.what_is_missing: The definition itself: no Lean declaration introduces the relation 'α ≪β' ('α/β is required to be sufficiently small, with the allowed size depending on all data already fixed'), nor the global rule 'In a chain of constants, choices proceed from right to left; small reciprocals specify large parameters', nor the uniformity clause 'For expressions depending on profile variables, this smallness is uniform on the stated domain'. What exists is (a) a concrete numeric range SmallParameters (h ≤ 1/1000, j ≤ 1/1000) and (b) explicit quantifier alternation in individual existence theorems (∃ M, ∀ Λ ≥ M, ∃ C₀, ∀ C ≥ C₀, ...) with docstrings stating the order in prose. gate_answer: (1) The 5 PARTIAL statements — what is missing, per statement: Theorem 3.1 is WEAKER — items (i)-(iii) are present in different, distributed form (periodized curl-potential plus direct field; compatible one-sided limits via exists_smooth_compatible_limits; AllJetsFlat residual; exact heat exterior K = r^{-1-2h}H_ext(τ/r²) with zero residual), but item (iv) 'uθ(√(2Xinτ), 0, 0, 1 −τ) = τ^{−A}(e0 + O(τ^{2h}))' is replaced by an exact (1−t)^{−A} formula for the BASE field at r = 0 and mere SpeedUnboundedAtOne for the assembled candidate; no O(τ^{2h}) error term, no path r = √(2Xin τ), no constants Xin, e0, and no theorem on Ω∗ with the four items. Definition 3.3 is NOT-A-THEOREM-IN-LEAN — the relation '≪', the right-to-left chain rule and the 'uniform on the stated domain' clause have no declaration; they are replaced per theorem by explicit ∃/∀ alternation (exists_reference_bounds, exists_outgoing_profile) and a numeric SmallParameters range. Lemma 4.4 is MISSING-CLAUSE (ii): the general estimate (4.17) '∥∆(Qs, Ns, ps)∥k ≤Ck(∥∆(U, E)∥k+1 + ∥∆m∥k+1)' for all k with its constant-dependence list and 'No radial derivative of a difference occurs' is absent; only the order-zero lag-stock Lipschitz instances (profile_stocks_lipschitz, actual_observation_estimate) exist, and no p_s difference estimate; (i) is present in different form (pressure_equal_after, modified_fields_after). Corollary 7.3 is PRESENT-IN-DIFFERENT-FORM — no statement about 'the solution operators fm ↦→(tm, πm) ... on the same domain 0 < q < q∗'; instead one qbig is fixed once and every stage is typed on localDomain h qbig, harmonic damping monotonicity is high_harmonic_damping/homogeneous_forward_bound, and 'changes constants and polynomial degrees' is the per-order ∃ A p of NativeBounds on a fixed domain. Lemma 9.7 is MISSING-CLAUSE: the sentence 'For every fixed stage and output amplitude derivative, its construction and estimate require finitely many input amplitude derivatives' (the DAG derivative-count recursion) has no Lean statement, only FiniteJetBound-shaped hypotheses and docstrings; the common-qbig sentence is present in different form (qbig B N0, actual_coherent_families_support). For all five, the answer to 'does the missing clause weaken the exported theorem statements navier_stokes_breakdown_R3/_periodic via the import path' is NO: the exported Props are closed comparator statements, the call chain consumes only CandidateProperties (in particular speed_unbounded = SpeedUnboundedAtOne) and R3CompactCandidate.Properties, and none of the missing clauses is a hypothesis of any theorem on that chain; import-closure membership of all 17 pointer modules was confirmed and is necessary, not sufficient, for use. Nothing here is a proof check.
